title: December at The Anchor
preheader: The lights are up, the festive nights are booked, and everyone is welcome.

data.alt: The Anchor, Stanwell Moor Village, since 1751. Holly, pine cones and Christmas greenery around the wordmark.

data.heading: December is finally here
body: Which means we can officially stop pretending it's too early to get excited about Christmas. The lights are twinkling and the festive drinks are flowing. There's something about this time of year that makes even an ordinary evening feel a bit special.

A cosy dinner with the family, a few drinks with friends, or one of those brilliantly festive nights out. This is the month for making memories. We can't quite believe it's here already, and we're making the most of every Christmassy moment.

events.name: Tinsel & Trivia Quiz Night
events.detail: Teams of up to six, £3 cash on the night, with just enough tinsel in the questions to feel festive.

image.alt: Tinsel and Trivia Quiz Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

events.name: Sleigh My Name Festive Music Bingo
events.detail: Two rounds of festive songs with Nikki hosting. £5 cash, and singing along is very much the point.

image.alt: Sleigh My Name festive music bingo at The Anchor

events.name: Christmas Jackpot Cash Bingo
events.detail: £10 a book for ten games, a rollover Snowball, and a cash jackpot to see the year out.

cards.body: Sunday 20 December is the last sitting of the year, from four of you up. Don't leave it too late.

data.heading: Between Christmas and the new year
body: The bar stays open through the quiet days. There's a lot to be said for a pint somewhere warm when the house is full of relatives. The dates that differ are all above, and the kitchen's back to normal on Tuesday 12 January.

data.script_line: Happy Christmas from all of us
data.body: Thank you for a brilliant year. Whether we see you at the quiz, round a Christmas table, or on a quiet afternoon in between, you're always welcome here.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you enquired about a booking or an event with us, because you said we could get in touch, or because you are just down the road and we thought this would be useful. It may have been a while ago now, and it is good to still be in touch.
